name: Lia
source:
Color: Pink
Sin: Pride

A girl out of time. Fragile on the outside, surprisingly strong within. Lia is determined to survive without dissolving into someone else’s story. Here, she belongs to no one, and no one knows anything about her past. A cold mind paired with the ability to support the people beside her. Pride, inner kindness, and desperate courage woven together. A ghost of a former life who still chooses to be the heroine of her own story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314300/]Steam[/url]]
